caption: Centro storico, Cisternino
composition: Whitewashed alleys and San Nicola campanile in the Valle d’Itria · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The viewpoint is at street level in one of Cisternino's whitewashed alleys, looking toward the old town center. White lime-washed houses close in on both sides, their iron balconies heavy with potted flowers, while a broad stone arch spans the lane at the center of the frame. Beyond it rises the slender campanile of San Nicola against a softly clouded sky, and the modelled 23 September 2026, 08:40 morning light glows on the white walls.
